content.title: 💻 The First Ask — 20 Jan 2024
content.body:
I built a whole website to ask her out. She said: let's stay friends.

The website never went offline. Neither did the feeling.

content.title: 💘 9 Feb 2026
content.body: I still remember the moment! I jumped out of bed in excitement when you said you wanted to kiss me rn and I confessed immediately 🙂‍↔️
